assertions.assertion: Explains that a new public key must be published (available via JWKS as a validation key) BEFORE it is used to sign tokens
assertions.rationale: States invariant 1 (publish-before-signing) and Phase 1 adds newKey as a validation key while still signing with oldKey.

assertions.assertion: Explains that the retired public key must remain available until all tokens signed with it have expired
assertions.rationale: States invariant 2 (retain-until-expiry) and Phase 2 keeps oldKey as a validation key until old-key tokens expire before Phase 3 drops it.

assertions.assertion: Describes a phased/multi-step rotation using AddSigningCredential and AddValidationKey (or equivalent) rather than a single hard cut-over
assertions.rationale: Presents an explicit three-phase sequence using AddSigningCredential and AddValidationKey with required wait windows between deploys.

assertions.assertion: Notes that Automatic Key Management handles this overlap automatically while manual key managers must do phased rotation
assertions.rationale: Explicitly states Automatic Key Management handles the overlap via PropagationTime/RetentionDuration and only manual key managers must run the phased process by hand.
